risks.risk: The transmission may have internal faults or may not work at all.
risks.proof: Video of the unit shifting through gears under load or a bench test with oil pressure.

risks.risk: Mileage and age of the unit are unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the identification or date sticker, or service records.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage or unknown age.

risks.risk: Fitment to a specific vehicle make, model or year is unknown.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the ID plate plus a fitment list.

risks.risk: Internal parts such as solenoids and valve body may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the open valve body, solenoid pack or full parts layout.

risks.risk: The torque converter may not be included or may be faulty.
risks.proof: Photo of the torque converter with markings and a video of it being installed.

risks.proof: Written warranty document or screenshot of return policy.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as sold as-is with no returns.

proof_requests: Clear photo of any identification plate or sticker showing part number, model and date code.
Video of the transmission operating or a bench test demonstrating gear engagement.
Photo showing the valve body, solenoids and torque converter together to confirm completeness.
Seller's location and verified contact details in Abuja.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a car transmission, so a worst-case price is possible; all condition, model and completeness claims remain unproven.
